title: adheaping: Characteristic-Function De-Heaping Density Estimation
description: An R package for tuning-free kernel density estimation of heaped and rounded data by characteristic-function de-heaping inside the grid-Nyquist band. Provides the de-heaping, superposition and combined estimators, readers for the grid, the heaped fraction and a mixture of rounding grains, and a fourth-order comb detector, together with base-R replicas of the measurement-error deconvolution and Heitjan-Rubin multiple-imputation baselines.
